title: Human Organs
description: Major organs of the human body, their organ system, function, and location.

results.name: Brain
results.function: Controls thought, movement, and body functions and processes sensory information.

results.name: Spinal cord
results.function: Relays signals between the brain and the rest of the body.

results.name: Heart
results.function: Pumps blood throughout the body.

results.name: Lungs
results.function: Exchange oxygen and carbon dioxide between air and blood.
results.location: Thoracic cavity, either side of the heart

results.name: Trachea
results.function: Conducts air between the larynx and the bronchi.

results.name: Diaphragm
results.function: Contracts to draw air into the lungs during breathing.
results.location: Below the lungs, separating chest and abdomen

results.name: Liver
results.function: Filters blood, produces bile, and stores nutrients.

results.name: Stomach
results.function: Breaks down food using acid and enzymes.

results.name: Small intestine
results.function: Absorbs most nutrients from digested food.

results.name: Large intestine
results.function: Absorbs water and forms and stores feces.

results.name: Esophagus
results.function: Carries food from the throat to the stomach.
results.location: Behind the trachea, from throat to stomach

results.name: Pancreas
results.function: Secretes digestive enzymes and regulates blood sugar via insulin.

results.name: Gallbladder
results.function: Stores and concentrates bile produced by the liver.

results.name: Kidneys
results.function: Filter blood to produce urine and regulate fluid balance.
results.location: Posterior abdomen, either side of the spine

results.name: Urinary bladder
results.function: Stores urine before it is expelled from the body.

results.name: Ureters
results.function: Carry urine from the kidneys to the bladder.

results.name: Urethra
results.function: Conducts urine from the bladder out of the body.

results.name: Skin
results.function: Protects the body, regulates temperature, and senses the environment.
results.location: Entire external surface of the body

results.name: Spleen
results.function: Filters blood and helps fight infection.
results.location: Upper left abdomen, behind the stomach

results.name: Thymus
results.function: Matures T-lymphocytes for the immune system.

results.name: Tonsils
results.function: Trap pathogens entering through the mouth and nose.

results.name: Thyroid gland
results.function: Secretes hormones that regulate metabolism.

results.name: Pituitary gland
results.function: Master gland that regulates other endocrine glands.

results.name: Adrenal glands
results.function: Produce hormones such as adrenaline and cortisol.

results.name: Eyes
results.function: Detect light to provide the sense of vision.

results.name: Ears
results.function: Detect sound and help maintain balance.

results.name: Tongue
results.function: Manipulates food, aids speech, and senses taste.

results.name: Ovaries
results.function: Produce egg cells and female sex hormones.
results.location: Pelvis, either side of the uterus

results.name: Uterus
results.function: Houses and nourishes a developing fetus.

results.name: Testes
results.function: Produce sperm and male sex hormones.

results.name: Prostate gland
results.function: Produces fluid that nourishes and transports sperm.
